request: AI Core short realistic Coder 4-caller bounded queue fair-share and memory/CPU snapshot; use existing Gate only, no products changed

bounded_host_request.command:
tmp=$(mktemp)
docker exec -i ai-core-model-gate python3 - <<'PY' > "$tmp" 2>&1
import os,json,time,threading,urllib.request,urllib.error
base='http://127.0.0.1:18184'
h={'Authorization':'Bearer '+os.environ['AI_CORE_API_KEY']}
def get(p):
 with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+p,headers=h),timeout=10) as r:return json.load(r)
def call(name,wait):
 d={'model':model,'messages':[{'role':'user','content':'Reply OK.'}],'max_tokens':8}
 hs={**h,'Content-Type':'application/json','X-AI-Core-Client':name,'X-AI-Core-Wait-Ms':str(wait)}
 t=time.monotonic()
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+'/v1/chat/completions',headers=hs,data=json.dumps(d).encode()),timeout=200) as r:
   out=json.load(r);return [name,r.status,round(time.monotonic()-t,2),len(out.get('choices',[]))]
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:return [name,e.code,round(time.monotonic()-t,2)]
model=get('/v1/models')['data'][0]['id']
initial=get('/internal/handoff/status')
if any(initial['active'].values()) or initial['handoff'] or initial['recovery_pending']:raise RuntimeError('GATE_NOT_QUIESCENT')
warm=call('warm',0)
results=[None]*4
def run(i,name):results[i]=call(name,30000)
threads=[]
for i,name in enumerate(['a','a','b','c']):
 t=threading.Thread(target=run,args=(i,name));threads.append(t);t.start();time.sleep(.08)
for t in threads:t.join(210)
after=get('/internal/handoff/status')
resources=get('/internal/resources/status')
print(json.dumps({'warm':warm,'calls':results,'released':not any(after['active'].values()),'queued':resources['queued'],'memory_current':resources['memory']['memory.current'],'cpu_stat':resources['cpu_stat'],'psi':resources['pressure']},ensure_ascii=False))
PY
rc=$?
gh api -X POST repos/G-ACE-inc/server-core/issues/10/comments -f "body=AI_CORE_REAL_QUEUE_COMPACT
$(tail -c 2400 "$tmp")" --jq .html_url
cat "$tmp"
rm -f "$tmp"
exit "$rc"
